name: HaloDomeHouse_12
note: HouseB (26 x 18 x 28, wide). Rect body 21 x 15, two storeys (door + two arched windows below; three arched windows above the awning), gold corner pilasters with storey bands, double arched door with lantern pedestals, navy/cream awning, two big front flower pots, roof terrace with a marble balustrade and two topiary bushes. Missing: rooftop pergola with gold columns and hanging ivy, window boxes under the upper windows, ivy on the walls, yellow scallops on the awning (only two awning colours exist) (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloDomeHouse_12_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG and side view are not in the worktree.
